case.pattern_description: The pattern involves several online purchases executed within a short timeframe, each kept just under the $500 authorization threshold to evade detection. It affects cardholders through rapid, unauthorized online billing episodes. It was found via graph analysis identifying clustered card history and device profile associations.

case.summary: Case HHG-006 was opened following a customer report from customer C07297 regarding an unauthorized online purchase on card C07297-K1. Graph analysis confirmed a fraud probability of 0.90 based on an undocumented structuring pattern of 4 online purchases totaling $1,906.07. Because the probability exceeds the threshold and rests on independent evidence, recommended actions include blocking the card via L1, creating a case automatically, and filing a report via L2 under §3a.
